title: The Language of Milton Flats
author: Silas Sterling
blurb: Gideon Crane, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
